description: This file implements the core operational functions of the Bbhm Diagnostic Executor Object, including its engagement and cancellation routines. It contains function definitions such as BbhmDiageoEngage and BbhmDiageoCancel, with the latter managing the object's active state and coordinating event handling during cancellation.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiageoEngage(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Engages the diagnostic executor object, currently implemented to simply return success without additional actions.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiageoCancel(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cancels the diagnostic executor object activity, resets relevant events, updates internal state, and manages synchronization to ensure proper termination of ongoing operations.
